bug_semantics: Standalone FastAPI servers default DATABASE_URL to well-known PostgreSQL credentials (postgresql://telemetry:telemetry@localhost:5432/telemetry and later postgresql://keyserver:keyserver@localhost/keyserver). If operators deploy without overriding DATABASE_URL, anyone who can reach the Postgres port authenticates with those published defaults.
